scope: Desktop mock-time tests of the STM32 controller drop-sensor logic; no real sensor, pulse widths or release timing (O-05)

problem_reproduced.description: Old controller ignored the sensor during SORT_RELEASE and reset the watch when the release finished, so a part that fell during release timed out as DROP_FAILED

behaviour: SORT_ROTATE_BIN: latest beam state tracked; watch armed only by a clear beam
SORT_RELEASE: sensor sampled with the same debounce; a confirmed drop is held (drop_confirmed)
Release complete: held drop reported (count, display, DROP_SUCCESS) only now; otherwise SORT_WAIT_DROP_SENSOR with sensor state carried over
Drop timeout still starts at release completion (O-02 unchanged)
Beam blocked throughout alignment/release/wait is never counted
drop_confirmed cleared on new target, bin alignment, success and failure
new_tests: test_drop_during_release_is_counted_after_release (incl. bounce counted once, no report before release ends, no leak into next target)
not_covered: Pulses shorter than the tick period (needs O-05 waveform data; may require interrupt capture)
Real release duration, sensor polarity and mounting (O-03, O-05, S-06)
Stuck beam / wrong bin diagnosis policy (O-06, R-09)
